name: Text to speech (Kokoro-82M)
description: Synthesises each input text to a 24 kHz mono 16-bit WAV with the open Kokoro-82M model (Apache-2.0, OWNER DECISION to confirm) using weights baked into the image. Verified by log-mel spectrogram similarity. See kits/text-to-speech/README.md.

verification.owner_decision: OWNER DECISION: log-mel spectrogram cosine similarity between the host's WAV and an independent re-run must be at least min_cosine (0.90) and durations within max_duration_diff_s (0.25 s); conservative placeholders to be tuned with cross-GPU benchmark data (U5.3). Unreadable or missing reference data is inconclusive, never a failure of the host. Sample fraction also pending owner approval.
